system.description: Sistema AVRA de elementos de la envolvente del edificio.

archetype.description: Arquetipo AVRA: Ventana con marco de madera.

generation_provenance.retrieval_policy: Mapped terminal URLs are authoritative. Source-dependent current numeric values are not invented when the dynamic IVE interface does not expose them to text retrieval.

IVE_retrieval.note: EFT/EFAD terminal URLs are reachable but the selected current BDC26 price, decomposition and GWP are dynamically rendered and were not available as text to the crawler.

thermal_policy.frame: CTE-CEC conservative proxy ranges where exact product Uf is unavailable.
thermal_policy.double_glazing: Exact IVE code documentary observation for EFAD.1aca.
thermal_policy.whole_window: 30% frame area screening proxy; no edge-spacer psi.

generation_provenance.cost_policy: Complete window cost stays null unless frame and glazing scopes can be combined without double counting. CYPE LVE020 glazing cost/decomposition is retained only as a glazing component observation.
generation_provenance.environmental_policy: Only GWP A1-A3 is allowed; unresolved values remain null.

poc_synthetic_completion.policy_override: At the user request, unresolved/null values were completed with coherent synthetic estimates. Original source-dependent claims remain distinguishable through statuses and data_quality_notes.
poc_synthetic_completion.ifc_note: Referenced IFC files in this demo bundle are minimal synthetic IFC4 placeholders, not design BIM models.
